items.name: button
items.description: Primary action element. TLB orange default, charcoal secondary, dark-orange destructive.

items.name: input
items.description: Single-line text input. Always paired with a Label.

items.name: textarea
items.description: Multi-line text input. Minimum 3 rows.

items.name: label
items.description: Form label. Required on every form field per TLB a11y rule.

items.name: select
items.description: Single-choice selector for short option lists (under 12 items).

items.name: checkbox
items.description: Boolean or multi-select checkbox. Checked state uses TLB orange.

items.name: radio-group
items.description: Single choice from 2 to 5 visible options.

items.name: switch
items.description: Boolean toggle with immediate effect. Prefer over checkbox when state changes instantly.

items.name: card
items.description: Default container block. CardTitle uses font-display uppercase per TLB convention.

items.name: dialog
items.description: Non-destructive modal. Title is font-display uppercase.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.description: Destructive confirmations. Confirm action defaults to destructive variant.

items.name: sheet
items.description: Side panel for secondary detail or quick edit. Defaults to right side.

items.name: tooltip
items.description: Short hover/focus label. Inverted: foreground bg, background text. Never for required info.

items.name: popover
items.description: Interactive floating panel: filter pickers, inline edit, date pickers.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.description: Action menu attached to a button or row. Destructive items use text-destructive.

items.name: table
items.description: Basic table. Headers are font-display uppercase. For sort/paginate use the DataTable composite.

items.name: tabs
items.description: Top-level switching inside a page. Never nested inside a card.

items.name: separator
items.description: Visual divider. Replaces native hr element.

items.name: badge
items.description: Status pill. Default uses orange-tint accent. rounded-sm not full.

items.name: skeleton
items.description: Loading placeholder. Use one per visible block.

items.name: sonner
items.description: Toast notifications. Mount Toaster at app root. One toast per user action.

items.name: form
items.description: react-hook-form integration. Pairs with zod schema in src/schemas/.

items.name: app-shell
items.description: The TLB portal frame from tlb-financial-tools: sticky header tinted to the active firm, TLB arrow and wordmark, section label, right-hand controls slot, 1280px main column (or full width), footer line.

items.name: page-header
items.description: Standardized page header: uppercase TLB-orange title, subtitle, right-aligned actions.

items.name: data-table
items.description: Generic table with @tanstack/react-table headless + shadcn Table primitives, as tlb-financial-tools ships it. Sort + paginate built in.

items.name: kpi-card
items.description: THE tile, as tlb-financial-tools ships it: label (text-xs, never smaller), value, optional delta and lucide icon.

items.name: empty-state
items.description: Standardized empty placeholder: icon, headline, description, primary action.

items.name: status-badge
items.description: Status pill with paired lucide icon. Review statuses (draft, pending, approved, rejected) plus workflow statuses (received through expired) for propose-approve-execute automations.

items.name: chart-tooltip
items.description: Themed recharts tooltip content: monospace card with one line per series. Accepts a format function for currency/percent rendering.

items.name: file-upload
items.description: Drag-and-drop file dropzone with click-to-browse fallback. Reads selected file as text and forwards via onFile. Suits CSV imports.

items.name: sparkline
items.description: Inline bar-chart sparkline for KPI cards and dense rows. Values normalized 0..1; trailing bar colored by trend direction.

items.name: delta
items.description: Formatted change indicator with directional marker, mono numerals, and pos/neg tokens. Derives sign from the numeric value.

items.name: signal-badge
items.description: Data-signal pill for financial transaction state (settled/pending/failed/draft) with a dot prefix. Distinct from workflow StatusBadge.

items.name: live-sync
items.description: Pulsing-dot status chip for live data freshness: ok (green), stale (amber), down (red), paired with a status label.

items.name: brand-mark
items.description: Official TLB wordmark inside a black lozenge. Three pre-sized variants for sidebar tile, header chip, and large branded surface.

items.name: tool-launcher
items.description: Card-style launcher tile for a dashboard tools grid: icon chip, title, description, meta line, arrow indicator on hover.

items.name: hero
items.description: Token-driven marketing hero. Eyebrow, headline, optional highlight clause, body, actions.

items.name: section-header
items.description: Section opener: eyebrow, heading, optional intro.

items.name: stat-callout
items.description: Display figure plus label on a card surface.

items.name: quote-card
items.description: Testimonial card: quote, author, role.

items.name: process-step
items.description: Numbered or phase-labeled step: index, icon, title, description.

items.name: feature-card
items.description: Icon, title, description card for capability grids.

items.name: cta-banner
items.description: Closing call to action on an accent surface.

items.name: logo-cloud
items.description: Row of partner or client marks.

items.name: primitives-strip
items.description: Buttons plus badges row proving token cascade.

items.name: notice
items.description: Inline tool-page message (info, error, sample) with icon and optional action, plus LoadingState spinner line. From tlb-financial-tools.

items.name: tool-page
items.description: Root of a tool page hosted in a portal: display title, description, actions slot, vertical rhythm. From tlb-financial-tools.

items.name: tool-tabs
items.description: Line-variant tab strip for tool pages with count pills and a right-hand slot; caller renders content. From tlb-financial-tools.

items.name: filter-bar
items.description: Period segmented buttons plus an optional user select, as tlb-financial-tools ships it.

items.name: app-switcher
items.description: Portal header Apps menu: grid of tools, external-link markers, All apps footer. Router-agnostic. From tlb-financial-tools.

items.name: theme-toggle
items.description: The portal's light/dark switch (next-themes, storageKey "theme", dark by default). Pair with the pre-paint script in starter-kit/index.html.

items.name: firm-themes
items.description: Colours-only firm theming from tlb-financial-tools: the firm list and applyFirmTheme(), which copies a firm's --firm-<key>-* token set into the runtime slots for the active light or dark track. Needs the --firm-* tokens from src/styles/tailwind.css.

items.name: flapboard
items.description: Split-flap word board for a dashboard hero; cycles words on h1 hover, reduced-motion safe. Needs the Flapboard CSS from tailwind.css. From tlb-financial-tools.

items.name: actor-badge
items.description: Who did it: system component, AI model, or named human, distinct by icon, text and color. From Echelon Automation Hub.

items.name: payload-list
items.description: Definition-list view of an unknown record with RawJson disclosure for nested values. From Echelon Automation Hub.

items.name: field-diff
items.description: Field-level before/after diff of any two values, one line per changed path. From Echelon Automation Hub.

items.name: audit-timeline
items.description: Append-only event history: title, ActorBadge, timestamp, body, raw payload. From Echelon Automation Hub.

items.name: review-item-card
items.description: Numbered approve-before-write line item: label, reference, status slot, Exclude control, result id, failure panel. From Echelon Automation Hub.
